# data.docker_buildx_builder

<!-- Code generated by tools/genskill from the provider schema. DO NOT EDIT. -->

Kind: data-source. Back to [SKILL.md](../SKILL.md).

Reads one buildx builder, like `docker buildx inspect`: driver, nodes with endpoint, status, buildkitd flags, driver options, BuildKit version, platforms, worker labels and GC policy. The provider talks to BuildKit itself (the daemon's `/grpc` endpoint, or `buildctl dial-stdio` in a node container); it never runs buildx and does not read buildx's client-side builder store, so only builders on the provider's daemon are found, and `last_activity` is the newest node container's creation time.

## Arguments and attributes

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `builder` | `object` | computed |  |  | The builder object field by field (name, driver, last activity, nodes with endpoint, status, BuildKit version, platforms, labels, GC policy). |
| `buildkit_version` | `string` | computed |  |  | BuildKit daemon version of the first node (identity, not one of the six version names; see naming_questions). |
| `buildx_version` | `string` | computed |  |  | The buildx release whose output format and semantics this type mirrors (pin v0.38.2); not a runtime binary, the provider never runs buildx. |
| `content_sha256` | `string` | computed |  |  | SHA-256 of inspect_json, to detect drift without diffing the document. |
| `docker_server_version` | `string` | computed |  |  | Docker Engine version of the daemon (GET /version Version). |
| `driver` | `string` | computed |  |  | Builder driver: `docker` for the daemon's builder, `docker-container` otherwise. |
| `endpoint` | `string` | computed |  |  | Endpoint of the first node: `default`, or `docker-container://buildx_buildkit_<node>`. |
| `engine_api_version` | `string` | computed |  |  | Engine API version negotiated with the daemon for this read/apply. |
| `id` | `string` | computed |  |  | Builder id (the builder name). |
| `inspect_json` | `string` | computed |  | yes | The builder and its nodes as one JSON document (the `docker buildx inspect` view, keys as in `buildx ls --format json` Builder object). Sensitive: driver options carry env.* values. |
| `labels` | `map(string)` | computed |  |  | BuildKit worker labels of the first node (`org.mobyproject.buildkit.worker.*`). |
| `name` | `string` | optional, computed |  |  | Builder to inspect, as for `docker buildx inspect <name>`. Default `default`, the daemon's built-in BuildKit (buildx's `docker` driver); any other name is a docker-container builder whose node containers `buildx_buildkit_<name><n>` run on the provider's daemon. |
| `platforms` | `list(string)` | computed |  |  | Platforms the builder can build for, the union over its nodes (empty for nodes that are not running). |

## Example

```terraform
# The daemon's own BuildKit (buildx's "default" builder).
data "docker_buildx_builder" "default" {}

# A docker-container builder, e.g. one made by docker_buildx_builder.
data "docker_buildx_builder" "ci" {
  name = "ci"
}

output "ci_buildkit" {
  value = {
    version   = data.docker_buildx_builder.ci.buildkit_version
    platforms = data.docker_buildx_builder.ci.platforms
    status    = [for n in data.docker_buildx_builder.ci.builder.nodes : "${n.name}: ${n.status}"]
  }
}
```
